step1_analysis.description: A two-stage CMOS operational amplifier configured as a non-inverting unity-gain buffer. It consists of an NMOS differential pair with a PMOS current mirror active load, followed by a PMOS common-source second stage. The output is directly fed back to the inverting input.

paper_reference.title: A 13.56MHz Wireless Power and Data Transfer Receiver Achieving 75.4% Effective-PowerConversion Efficiency with 0.1% ASK Modulation Depth and 9.2mW Output Power

system_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the wireless power transfer system

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric. The buffer's bandwidth should exceed this frequency to avoid signal attenuation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The buffer must have a bandwidth higher than the system frequency to process signals effectively.

system_efficiency.description: Effective power conversion efficiency of the receiver

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric. The buffer's low power consumption contributes to the overall efficiency.

ask_modulation_depth.description: ASK modulation depth supported by the receiver

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric for the data receiver path.

output_power.description: Total output power of the wireless receiver

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric. The buffer itself drives a small internal capacitive load, not the main output power.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the buffer

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail + I_stage2 = 2 * 1/2 * un * Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs-Vth)^2. With Vgs=0.6V, Vth=0.42V, I ~ 2 * 0.5 * 270u * 10 * 0.032 = 86uA. Power = 86uA * 1.8V = 155uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters and 0.6V bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideally 0V, limited by finite gain and systematic mismatch between stage 1 output and stage 2 input.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High open-loop gain reduces closed-loop DC offset.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2 * pi * Cc). With gm1 ~ 1mA/V and CL=1pF, GBW ~ 160MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance (1pF assumed in testbench).

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_tail / CL. With I_tail = 43uA and CL = 1pF, SR = 43 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the tail current and load capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, offset, AC bandwidth, and transient slew rate of the unity-gain buffer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Two-Stage Op-Amp Unity-Gain Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.6
VBIAS2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.6
* Input biased at 1.1V to keep NMOS diff pair in saturation
VIN LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 1.1 ac 1 pulse(0.8 1.4 1n 1n 1n 4u 8u)

CL N1 0 1p

XM1 N2 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let dc_offset = v(N1) - v(LABEL_NET_3)
  print power dc_offset

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 1k 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(N1)
  * Unity gain buffer has ~0dB DC gain, measure bandwidth at -3dB
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 10n 10u
  * Measure rise and fall times for a 0.4V step (0.9V to 1.3V)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.3 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(N1) val=1.3 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
  print t_rise t_fall
  * Slew rate can be calculated as 0.4V / t_rise and 0.4V / t_fall

  * 4. DC Sweep (Linearity Range)
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vout_min min v(N1)
  meas dc vout_max max v(N1)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
